name: open-coworking-stack
description: A practical, verified directory of free, open-source, source-available, freemium, and free-to-try technology for coworking and flexible-workspace operators.

scripts.build:validators: pnpm --filter @ocs/schema build && pnpm --filter @ocs/shared build && pnpm --filter @ocs/validators build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:pipeline && pnpm -r run test
scripts.generate: pnpm run build:pipeline && pnpm --filter @ocs/schema generate && prettier --write "catalog/schema/*.json" && pnpm --filter @ocs/generators generate && prettier --write "apps/web/src/content/docs/workflows/generated/*.md"
scripts.check: pnpm validate && pnpm generate && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:evidence: pnpm release:licenses && pnpm release:sbom && pnpm release:checksums
